purpose: Prevent incomplete, caller-shifted, weakly evidenced, or ambiguously selected utilization samples from being promoted to P0 acceptance evidence. The historical filename is retained for compatibility; active P0 candidates are fixed 900-second wall-clock windows.
scheduler_independence: Measurement boundaries do not recreate or depend on retired quarter-hour scheduler choreography.
selection_policy: Among completed canonical windows, identify consecutive VALID_ACCEPTED streaks. Prefer the longest streak; equal-length ties prefer the freshest fully observed streak. When the selected streak contains more than the minimum required windows, compute the acceptance rolling mean over its freshest minimum-required windows.
pass_rule: P0 PASS requires at least 3 consecutive VALID_ACCEPTED fixed completed windows and rolling mean observed useful seconds >=840 over the deterministically selected freshest required subset; one accepted window never completes P0.
anti_inference_rule: Absence of evidence is unknown time, not useful time. Never bridge unknown intervals merely because endpoint commits are substantive.
anti_gaming_rule: Do not manufacture commits or split trivial changes to satisfy cadence; materially new work is required by control/evidence-policy.v1.json.
